scope: Native PostgreSQL fresh-primary skill cooldown durability without a primary Map transfer.

behavior: TSaveSkill stages (character, skill ID, rank, remaining tick) in TTEMPSKILLTABLE.
TLogout replaces learned skills from staging. TSaveCharDataEnd has the skill replacement commented out; modern periodic skill persistence is an explicit durability improvement.
Server/TMapSvr/SSSender.cpp samples GetReuseRemainTick(m_dwSaveTick); SSHandler.cpp restores nonzero remaining duration on the local process clock. No offline wall-clock decay is introduced.

implementation.snapshot: Fresh periodic/final persistence samples live timers into a copied payload without creating a transfer graph. Expired timers become zero; unknown active skill IDs fail closed.
implementation.write: The existing owned/account-locked transaction validates all learned IDs and ranks, updates only dwRemainTick, and commits core, skill receipt, audit and session release atomically.
implementation.receipt: Core plus sorted unsigned [skill ID, rank, remaining milliseconds]. Same-revision and lost-final-response confirmations require exact skill values; skill ordering does not change identity.
implementation.fencing: Process, connection and authority epoch checks retained. Current core and skill rows must agree with their receipt before save, primary transfer and owner recovery.
implementation.permissions: Map gains UPDATE(dwRemainTick) only, plus EXECUTE on invoker-only state comparison functions. No skill INSERT/DELETE/rank update or historical access.
implementation.compatibility: Contracts 1 and 2 remain readable; complete transfer graphs retain contract 2. Fresh relogin reads ordinary database state instead of transferring mail/account semantics into the wire graph.
implementation.deployment: Apply 021 and deploy/sql/map-runtime-grants.sql before the new binary. Do not run old Map binaries against new contract-3 ready receipts.

regression_before.expected_failure: Map runtime wait: periodic fresh-primary checkpoint advances live cooldown without transfer
regression_before.scope: Previous installed daemon plus the current integration executable, against the same new encrypted TCP assertion and migrated disposable PostgreSQL.

limitations: Original client executable not run; protocol evidence uses source-derived encrypted peers.
Learning, forgetting, rank changes, active effects, quest/recall/companion timers and other native gameplay remain unfinished.
Initial CHARINFO carries the loaded remaining duration; exact send-instant refresh is a separate follow-up.
Crashes retain the last committed checkpoint; transient state after it can be lost.
Migration and tests do not rewrite or import historical player records. Backups and migrations 001-020 retain their pinned hashes.
High-load database/tick profiling and full ancillary state synchronization remain pending.
